Question Choices: A phone plan costs $30 after 5 GB of data and $50 after 10 GB. Assuming a linear relationship, what is the base fee (cost when data = 0)?
Hints: Use y=mx+b. If m and a point (x,y) are known, b=y−mx. If the point has x=0, its y-value already gives b.
Solution: Use y=mx+b. If m and a point (x,y) are known, b=y−mx. If the point has x=0, its y-value already gives b. Slope = (50-30)/(10-5) = 4 → 30 = 4(5) + b → b = 10 Calculation: 30-((50-30)/(10-5)) × 5 = 10. Requested answer: 10.

Hints: Slope is change in y divided by change in x, subtracting both coordinates in the same order.
Solution: Slope is change in y divided by change in x, subtracting both coordinates in the same order. (270-150)/(6-3) = 120/3 = 40 Calculation: (270-150)/(6-3) = 40. Requested answer: 40.
